references.text: Contains the same lex talionis formula: 'life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot, burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.'
Repeats the principle of just retribution: 'break for break, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. The injury he has caused another person, he shall receive in return.'
Uses the same expression 'your eye shall not show pity' in the context of God's judgment on enemies.
The same phrasing 'your eye shall not spare him' is used regarding punishing idolatry.
The same expression 'your eye shall not show pity' in connection with just punishment.
Jesus quotes this lex talionis law directly and gives a new interpretation: 'You have heard that it was said, Eye for eye and tooth for tooth. But I say to you, Do not resist an evil person.'
